title: Canon of the Shattering Wave
summary: A canon of the wave of sound that cracks the ground and the air and every guard in its way, closing on a dirge whose reach is the ceiling of the realm.

title: Treatise of the Last Resonance
summary: A treatise on the resonance that is last to fade and first to break a thing, closing on a requiem that ends a field of fighters at the ceiling of the Core realm.
